name: tpu_v5p_pod
_comment: TPU v5p slice: 16×16×16 = 4096 chips on a single 3D-torus ICI fabric (a full v5p pod is 8960 chips; the largest single-slice shape Google documents is 16×16×24 = 6144). ICI is published as 4800 Gbps per chip (= 600 GB/s per direction, 1200 GB/s bidirectional), i.e. 6 links/chip × 100 GB/s single-direction; ~1.0 us per-hop α is an assumption, not a published figure. Every collective walks the ici fabric; collectives at group sizes that align with prefix-products of (16,16,16) route through the torus primitives (collectives/02_topology_mapping.md §3). Non-prefix-aligned G falls back to the flat-ring bound with a UserWarning. Checked against the vendor's product page in November 2026: the TPU v5p page lists 459 TFLOPs per chip for BF16 and the same 459 for FP8, and no 4-bit mode, so the peak does not rise at lower precision (`peak_flops_TF_by_precision`; the 4-bit entry is an assumption).
